s1

s2

s3
No one does. Someone told you a date. A body appeared. And you decided, that's when I began.

s4
But that body has been rebuilding itself your whole life. Old cells die. New ones take their place.
But that body has been rebuilding itself your whole life. Old cells die. New ones take their place.
s5
Your thoughts changed. Your face changed. Even your name was given to you.
Your thoughts changed. Your face changed. Even your name was given to you.
s6
So what stayed, through all of it?
So what stayed, through all of it?
s7
The one who noticed. At five years old, it was watching. Right now, it's watching.
The one who noticed. At five years old, it was watching. Right now… it's watching.
s8
Can you find the moment that watching began?
Can you find the moment that watching began?
s9
You can't. To see a beginning, you'd already have to be there.
